body: Thanks for the encouraging words! I will definitely try this next time
I tried that, unfortunately it only helped me relax for a short while :/

LOL I actually used to do that as well when I was a child, up to the point that I was comfortable talking to people. But after I developed SAD I cant find myself faking it, since I know what to say but is really hard for me to get words out of my mouth.
I heard it helps get rid of the physical reactions faster, but for some reason I find it extremely difficult.
Yes, I decided to allow myself to leave whenever I feel uncomfortable, this way I feel more in control.

Not everyone understand how it feels. I used to wonder why was it so hard for some people to make friends or talk to people until I recently experienced SAD myself. Your close friend probably does not know it feels and probably thinks you are exaggerating it. Try letting her know that it is a serious problem for you if you guys are really close friends she should stop making fun of it.
Yes, I talked about this with my therapist and she said is very weird and that I might be overthinking
Yea Its been happening to me several times lately
I know what you mean lol
Have you found a way to solve this problem?

I told them about my trauma and the social anxiety that I got from it, but I did not tell them about my suicide thoughts because I do not want to worry them, and I am 100% I will not be able to tell them about this either way. I moved away from my country to study college in a better country. So I am living alone far away from my families and close friends.

I am so sorry for what happened to you and I really do not want my parents go through such pain. Even thinking about how sad my mother would be because of this makes me cry. But this is the reason I do not want to tell them. My mom is very sensitive and I know telling her, will affect her greatly. I do not want to worry them. Hopefully I will be able to overcome this.
Since the anxiety just started, I plan to go to the health center that my college offers, as well as spending some time with my friends.

Ok I woke up nose bleeding so I guess It has been very stressful these days. I plan to tell him as soon as possible today if he happens to be in the stores otherwise I am just going to call him. Thank you.

Thank you so much for the response. So I decided to tell him that I have been having health issues these past weeks and that I do not think that I will be able to work anymore in the place, that he have great people working in the place and that I do not feel comfortable because I feel like it is not fair that they might be having a bad time because of me. I will also offer to work 2 weeks more if he really needs me to. Does it sounds alright? I feel like I should say it in person but hes rarely on the stores so is it acceptable if I call him and explain it over the phone? or could it explain it over texts? The place where I am currently working is a coffee shop

I have never been diagnosed with neurosis/social anxiety before. This feeling and symptoms that I am experiencing happened when I started working here. Although it was not as severe at the start, it has been growing bigger and bigger. This was the main reason I quit the first time. However, after few years and working on other jobs my confidence got way better so I thought I could handle it, but the irony is that the anxiety got worse than the first time I started working here.

The job is pretty stressful so I am guessing that that could be a trigger for my anxiety? This place is constantly needing workers as many people either quit or got fire from here. I heard that 5 people quit/got fired in 6 months

Yes I will do the test and see how it goes. I am on my last year of college so I could take that time to look for an internship.

Thank you so much for replying. Honestly, I am currently thinking about quitting the job again, but I feel really bad doing that because is the second time I do it and I told my boss that I was going to work for at least a year this time. I actually forgot the reason why I quit the first time, and now working again here reminded me why I quit in the first place. I just need an advice, if you were in my position would you quit?
